author: vlogbrothers
description:
In which Hank rouses his deeply fatigued brother to make a reunion video that discusses everything from boats to poetry to the definition of art. 
Thanks to 30,000 (?!?!?!) of you I've met on tour. It's been the gift of a lifetime, and once I've gotten some sleep, I know the memories will buoy me for many years to come. This tour was just a pure joy. I didn't even get tired until like the 19th day!
